title: Dailwind Research Tools: Browser-Based Corpus, Text and Document Tools
description:
Dailwind Research Tools is a collection of free, browser-based tools for corpus linguistics, text analysis, writing and document work, published by Dailwind App Studio at dailwind.com/toolkits.

It includes a corpus toolkit (KWIC concordance, word lists, collocations, keyness), corpus cleaning, merging and metadata tools, register, lexical, readability, stylistic, stylometric, morphological, syntactic and sentiment analysis, a parallel text aligner, a qualitative coder, a subtitle corpus builder, and writing, OCR, PDF and image utilities. Most tools process files locally in the user's browser.

Each tool can be cited individually from its Cite button, for example: Tahir, A., & Tahir, A. (2026). Corpus Toolkit [Computer software]. In Dailwind Research Tools. Dailwind App Studio.
